title: Usability, Accessibility, and Equity
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting usability, accessibility, and equity to equity-oriented edtech evaluation matrix with context-specific risk notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Define usability, accessibility, and equity as three distinct checks with three distinct populations.
Run each check as its own test rather than inferring all three from a single smooth experience.
Recognize when a compliance badge (for example WCAG AA) does not match the tool's core task.
Document a decision that names which check failed, for whom, and what condition must be met before adoption.
